summary: End-to-end testing of US Bakers e-commerce app. All 11 backend API tests pass (categories, products list + filters, product detail, invalid slug 404, order create/get/404, custom order). Full frontend flows verified via Playwright: home load, shop grid (16 products), category filter (/shop/birthday -> 4 products), product detail add-to-cart (cart-count updates to 2), cart -> checkout, Razorpay path correctly blocked with info toast, COD path successfully creates order and redirects to /order/{id}, and custom-order form submits successfully and redirects to home.

react_warnings.issue: Calls navigate('/cart') during render when items.length===0, producing React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Checkout).' Move the redirect into a useEffect.

action_items: Optional: move the empty-cart redirect in Checkout.jsx from render body into useEffect to eliminate the React setState-in-render warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /orders POST does not validate items array is non-empty or that total matches item sums; acceptable for MVP but consider server-side recompute of total.
Checkout.jsx: navigate() called during render instead of inside useEffect (React warning).
All interactive elements correctly expose data-testid; MongoDB _id is excluded via projection; env vars used properly on both sides.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 16 products on startup if collection empty; tests created TEST_-prefixed orders and one custom order (not cleaned, low risk).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and frontend fully green. Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_usbakers_api.py. Razorpay is intentionally deferred (info toast only). Only known nit: Checkout redirect-during-render warning.
